criteria.criterion: Where a brief's runs hold a verify session, the summary adds it after gate review as gate review's is added: ` · verify <m> min` on the time line, ` · verify <c>` on the cost line, ` · verify <models>` on the models line. The total cost includes it; agent does not.
criteria.evidence: print.go appends the three suffixes after gate review; time.go adds Verify to Cost.Total and not to agent; TestPrintSummaryVerify asserts them

criteria.criterion: The instructions line adds ` · verify <n>` after `review <n>` when the measured tree holds plugin/skills/verify/SKILL.md (its words plus the shared CLAUDE.md and guidelines words, as the other kinds count), and leaves it out otherwise.
criteria.evidence: instructions.go kind("verify","") returns nil when the skill is absent and shared+words otherwise; print.go adds it only when non-nil

criteria.criterion: --json gains time.verify_ms, cost.verify_usd, models.verify, effort.verify and instructions.verify; schemas/metrics.v2.json gains them as optional properties; the schema stays metrics/v2.
criteria.evidence: metrics.go pointer fields with omitempty; schemas/metrics.v2.json diff adds five optional properties, schema id unchanged

criteria.criterion: A brief with no verify session prints exactly what it prints today, text and table.
criteria.evidence: all additions are conditional on nil pointers; test asserts an empty Report mentions no verify; go check passed

criteria.criterion: Committed tests, run by the checks, cover the three lines, the instructions line with and without the skill, the JSON fields and the unchanged output without a verify session. internal/metrics/print_test.go, internal/metrics/time_test.go and internal/metrics/instructions_test.go change only where they pin what V3 changes, and only to the new behaviour, the notes naming V3 for each.
criteria.evidence: print_test.go adds TestPrintSummaryVerify only; time_test.go and instructions_test.go untouched; no pre-existing test altered

notes: The committed unit test covers the instructions line only with the skill; the without-skill case rests on the gate and the nil return in MeasureInstructions.
